collectible.title: Peach's Panties
collectible.subtitle: Fit for a Princess
collectible.text: Princess Peach's royal panties are made of cloudsilk, spun from the cutest soft fluff of Fluff-Puff Peaks. They're light, airy, and taste just like fairy floss. The frills and bow add an extra measure of adorableness to hide underneath her pink princess dress.
